title: Three Wardens Fall - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Three Wardens Fall trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: Three Wardens Fall phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Three fights, and Heartpiercer drops the Sundering Dual Axes, which is why many builds end up finishing this one first.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat the three Shadow Wardens: Cavalrybane, Soulclaimer and Heartpiercer.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
